mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate, as a continuous variable, compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both increase in the prior month, it indicates a synchronized expansion in manufacturing and residential construction, boosting economic growth and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST rise by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a CPIAUCSL value above 215 (indicating persistent inflation) triggers further Federal Reserve rate hikes, which increase discount rates and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 215 during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 115 (index 2017=100) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential demand, which drives economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 138,000 (thousands) signals robust labor market conditions, which support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 138000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%.
